function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period, p.category, SUM(pl.qty) AS total_qty
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON pl.sku = p.sku
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period, p.category
ORDER BY pl.period, p.category","purpose":"Quantity by period and product category"}
